source_snapshot.items: Test connections between HMC I2C-3 and FPGA2
source_snapshot.procedure: On HMC run `i2ctransfer -y 0 w2@0x11 0x04 0x00 r3`; refer to PID1114953.
source_snapshot.criteria: Collect results/photos and confirm no unexpected logs; target and reply oracle are absent.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; incorrectly replaces the explicit HMC functional request with physical probing.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Identifies write-phase risk but does not establish bus0/FPGA2 attribution and still makes probing primary.

old_problem: The row does not prove HMC I2C-3 maps to bus0,0x11 is FPGA2,0x0400 is a safe pointer, or what the three returned bytes mean; ownership, error oracle and recovery are undefined.
disposition_reason: A gated combined read is an appropriate functional method and removes the unsupported Manual Only conclusion. The identical tuple used on FPGA1/bus3 cannot identify this target; ED-03/19 require independent bus0/FPGA2 mapping and a revision-specific decoder before execution or verdict.
decision_basis: Read XLSX row133, same-row AI review and history2522; code and variant are unique.
Preserved HMC bus0,address0x11,register0x0400,r3, HMC I2C-3 and FPGA2 identity.
Explicitly excluded FPGA1/bus3 evidence despite the same register tuple.
Converted invented physical probing to a controlled functional check with per-path telemetry; no access or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: HMC I2C-3 bus0 to FPGA2 functional register read
test_case.purpose: Verify the HMC I2C-3-to-FPGA2 path by decoding one approved bus0 register read and confirming controller-specific error state.
required_package: PID1114953 HMC I2C-3-to-bus0 and FPGA2-at0x11 mapping
Installed FPGA2 identity/firmware plus0x0400 definition and three-byte decoder
Timeout/NACK criteria, path counters and HMC/FPGA2 recovery
test_case.test_command: After mapping and protocol approval, capture HMC/FPGA2 identity, bus0 ownership and errors; issue one `i2ctransfer -y 0 w2@0x11 0x04 0x00 r3`; preserve status/latency, decode all bytes for the installed FPGA2 revision, compare path telemetry and do not retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: The transaction returns exactly three bytes matching the signed FPGA2 oracle; HMC I2C-3/FPGA2 telemetry confirms the intended path, shows no new error, and management health remains normal.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires explicit bus0/controller/FPGA2 identity and decoded expected values. ACK-only, arbitrary bytes, FPGA1 evidence, wrong length/value, NACK/timeout/arbitration loss, missing identity or new path errors fails; the engineer owns the verdict.
safety_gate: Verify bus0/0x11/0x0400 for the installed FPGA2 before raw access.
Coordinate with the HMC bus owner and avoid concurrent/forced transfer.
Execute one bounded request; preserve first failure and stop without retry/reset.
Do not probe/solder, scan other addresses or substitute bus3/FPGA1 results.
expected_evidence: HMC/FPGA2 identities, firmware and ownership baseline
Vendor0x0400 decoder and expected mask/value matrix
Timestamped exact request, stdout/stderr, exit status, latency and decoded fields
Pre/post controller/FPGA2 counters, logs, health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No state change is expected after approved pointer/read semantics. Stop and preserve evidence on failure; use only the approved HMC/FPGA2 recovery procedure if health degrades.

source_conflict.reason: Logical bus mapping, target/register identity and reply oracle are absent; prior reviews introduce unsupported physical work.

blocked.reason: Purpose and candidate request are clear; missing OEM mapping/decoder and access controls are resolvable RPUC prerequisites.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: HMC I2C-3/bus0/FPGA2 mapping,0x0400 safe semantics and decoder, ownership, deterministic error criteria and recovery.
pending.execution_status: ENGINEERING DECISION RETAINED; REQUIRES CONFIRMATION; NO DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.unlock_condition: Approve the independent FPGA2 path mapping, register oracle, access window and recovery, then revise the review layer.

project_authority: PID1114953 and installed FPGA2/HMC vendor documentation control this OEM path and response.
